name: vicinae-wolfram

description: Query the Wolfram Alpha Full Results API. List view shows text results, grid view shows image results.

commands.name: wolfram-query
commands.title: Query Wolfram Alpha
commands.subtitle: Computational answers
commands.description: Ask Wolfram Alpha anything. Enter copies the selected text result (list view) or image result (grid view).

commands.title: Wolfram Alpha History

commands.description: Results you copied are saved here. Open an entry to view its results again.
